# dodopayments_product_localized_price (List Resource)

Finds product localized prices to import with `terraform query`.

-> List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run "terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf" to write a resource block and an import block for each object.
list "dodopayments_product_localized_price" "all" {
  provider         = dodopayments
  include_resource = true

  config {
    product_id = "<product_id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (String) The ID of the product.
